label: Subsidiary / organizational unit of (secondary cluster)
definition: X is a subsidiary, division, or organizational unit of Y.
scope_notes: Use the same definition as rel_325. This cluster is outside the top 20 and is evaluated separately to inspect fragmentation. Geographic office metonymy and truncated broadcasting entity names require human review.
